propositions: The KNOWN_CAPABILITIES set is empty, preventing any capability from being recognized even though the store-compat validation mechanism exists and is fail-closed.

An older rebar binary reading a multi-project store without capability registration would incorrectly see non-configured projects as having no remote issues and create duplicates in the wrong project.

Registering multi-project-bridge in KNOWN_CAPABILITIES enables binaries to recognize the capability and raise StoreIncompatibleError on incompatible stores, refusing writes rather than corrupting data.
The write lock must reject stores declaring unknown capabilities, while read operations (list, show, search, fsck) remain available to older binaries.
Stores without a .store-compat.json record must continue to pass through as implicit legacy for backward compatibility with pre-feature stores.
